title: test_digest.rs: SHA/SHA3/SHAKE via digest::Digest (PR #10248)
description:
Write tests/test_digest.rs: test digest::Digest impls for all SHA variants against NIST KAT vectors.

## What
Verify that the sha_digest.rs trait impls (PR #10248) call the right wolfCrypt hash function and produce byte-exact NIST output.

## Algorithm
1. use wolfssl_wolfcrypt::{sha::{SHA, SHA224, SHA256, SHA384, SHA512, SHA3_224, SHA3_256, SHA3_384, SHA3_512}, sha_digest::*} (names TBD once PR #10248 is present)
2. Load vectors from testvectors/nist/sha_inline.rs (compiled-in constants).
3. For each (input, expected_output) pair in each algorithm's table:
   a. let mut h = SHAxxx::new();   // digest::Digest
   b. Digest::update(&mut h, input);
   c. let result = Digest::finalize(h);
   d. assert_eq!(result.as_slice(), expected_output, 'SHA-xxx vector N failed');
4. Multi-update test: split input at midpoint, call update twice, assert same output.
5. Reset test: update → reset → update → finalize; result must equal single-update result.
6. SHAKE128/SHAKE256 (XOF): use ExtendableOutput::finalize_xof, read output_len bytes, assert_eq.
7. Compile-time trait bound check: fn _check<H: digest::Digest>() {} called for each type (proves trait is implemented, not just inherent methods).

## Defensive rules
- Call common::init_wolfcrypt() at top of each test function (idempotent)
- Never call sha_digest functions via the wolfcrypt C FFI directly in tests — always go through the digest::Digest trait (this ensures we test the trait path, not the raw C path)
- If PR #10248 is not present, tests will fail to compile; this is expected and documents the gap

## Agent team
- Agent R: confirm exact type names in sha_digest.rs by reading PR #10248 diff; note exact feature flag needed to enable digest trait impls
- Agent I: write test_digest.rs per algorithm above
- Agent T: independently derive the same NIST SHA-256 test vector from FIPS 180-4 Appendix B.1; confirm it matches the inline constant

## Tests (oracles)
- SHA-256 of empty string: oracle = FIPS 180-4 Appendix B.1 = e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855
- SHA-256 of 'abc': oracle = FIPS 180-4 Appendix B.1 = ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2ec73b00361bbef0469421a80d7c7cc09f6b  
- SHA3-256 of empty: oracle = FIPS 202 example
- SHAKE128 output (16 bytes of empty input): oracle = FIPS 202 example
